title: Even-m distribution of the binary Niho s=4 cross-correlation
summary: Determine every correlation value and its exact multiplicity for the binary Niho decimation with s equal to four and even extension parameter.

formal_statement.body: For every positive even integer $m$, let $d=4(2^m-1)+1$ and let $C_d(\tau)$ be the cross-correlation between a binary m-sequence of period $2^{2m}-1$ and its $d$-decimated sequence. Determine all values of $C_d(\tau)$ and, for each value, the exact number of shifts $\tau\in\{0,\ldots,2^{2m}-2\}$ at which it occurs, as explicit functions of $m$.

scope.domain: Cross-correlation distributions of binary Niho-type m-sequence decimations
assumptions: The sequence and cross-correlation conventions are those of the source
scope.unresolved_remainder: For even $m$, the known theorem confines $C_d(\tau)$ to values in $\{-1+j2^m:j\in\{-1,0,1,2,4\}\}$. A 2026 preprint supplies a fourth equation for the distribution and states that one additional independent equation is still needed to determine all multiplicities for every positive even $m$.

progress.summary: The cited antecedent confines the even-$m$ correlation to the five possible values $\{-1+j2^m:j=-1,0,1,2,4\}$ without determining their multiplicities.
After the possible-value set for even $m$ was bounded, the source asks for the complete cross-correlation distribution and states that no method was known.

progress.summary: A later preprint derives a fourth equation for the value distribution and states that one further independent equation is still required for a complete determination.
